title: Stump
description: Adds Stumps, new cosy decoration blocks that let you sit down!
body:
![A player sitting on an Oak Stump around a campfire at night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a46cb2a9ddb38fa87dc8ec82fc43976d21ab1793.png)

## Stump

Stump is a small mod that adds Stumps - new decorative utility blocks that allow you to sit down by right-clicking! Stumps can be also be integrated nicely into builds (as branches, rocks, debris, etc)

### Fishing

Stumps also grant a small fishing bonus while sitting down, which can be paired with the rain's fishing bonus to make fishing pretty speedy
